race.comment: Few of these are close to a win. Liked the debut of EZYDOIT (11) who started at big odds but kept coming and just missed over the sharper trip on the synthetic at Devonport. Was strong through the line and looks suited by the extra ground. Can go one better. RED WINTER (2) also ran well on debut here over 1100m, trying to lead throughout before being grabbed late. Better for it and can give a sight again. NOBLE (1) returns off a long spell but has ability and is a winner of two trials leading into this. Appears primed to get back on track. TOORAK LAD (4) was fifth in the same race as RED WINTER fresh and can only be improved. PRECIOUS ILLUSION (12) will appreciate the extra trip and looks a solid top-three chance.
